About Me

Engineering precision, from design to delivery.

I'm Hans Xavier Dy, a Licensed Mechanical Engineer specializing in SolidWorks mechanical design and drafting for manufacturing and product teams — and a Quantity Surveyor and Construction Estimator with experience supporting residential, commercial, and industrial projects. Whether it's a 3D part model or a cost estimate, I bring the same attention to detail and technical accuracy to every deliverable.

What I Do

Mechanical design and drafting in SolidWorks, plus end-to-end estimating and project support for construction teams.

Why Clients Hire Me

I combine technical knowledge with industry experience, attention to detail, and clear communication.

My Philosophy

Every detail matters. Precision builds trust. Trust builds long-term partnerships.

My Mission

Deliver accurate, reliable engineering and estimating solutions that create value for manufacturing and construction teams.
